p: Acton High Street is part of the Uxbridge Road, the long main road heading west out of central London, so MERKUR here is right on a busy bus route with plenty of shops, cafés and takeaways nearby. Acton Central on the Overground and Acton Main Line on the Elizabeth line are both a short walk away. This is an 18+ venue.

For a change of scene, Acton Park is a nice green spot, and Gunnersbury Park, with its museum and grounds, is just to the south. Transport fans should look out for open days at the London Transport Museum's depot in Acton, packed with old buses, trams and tube trains.
